verdict.rationale: The docs say a customer can be a person or a company, and customers can be screened against sanctions, watchlists, PEP and adverse-media databases, so screening business entities is documented. Nothing in the pack shows that analysts can inspect linked ownership, beneficial owners or association networks, or the risk context those links carry. missing for 10: documented ownership/UBO or related-party linkage for screened companies, inspection of association risk context, independent or hands-on corroboration of company screening.
